statements.execute_exact: for every native-interface program and complete deployment state, PqxdhBoundaryProgram.execute (sourceStep setup codec reader erased checks serverSeed) work state = (fun result => (ok result.1, result.2)) <$> (simulateQ (PqxdhDeploymentNative.handler setup (withReader codec reader) checks (RawCtxFrameDecoding.sender reader.model) serverSeed) work).run state
statements.unwrap_okMap: unwrap (okMap outcome) = outcome for every CE game value: okMap loses nothing
statements.classical: PB-12/PB-14: (sourceGame setup codec reader erased checks ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode A).run runtime = okMap <$> (PqxdhDeploymentSecrecy.game setup (withReader codec reader) checks (RawCtxFrameDecoding.sender reader.model) ensureInit identityIndex bounds mode A).run runtime, for every setup, codec, reader, erased, checks, ensureInit, identity index, bounds, mode, adversary and runtime, on the full returned value (created Server, adversary output, ledger, complete deployment state with counters and produced frames, runtime)
statements.classical_zero: classical at identity index 0 (the CE-12 headline instance, PB-D pin #415)
statements.classical_normal: every supported source-game outcome is okMap of a supported CE game outcome; the source game never returns fail or div
statements.classical_continuation: (sourceGame ...).run runtime >>= next = (game ...).run runtime >>= fun outcome => next (okMap outcome), for every continuation next
statements.classical_observe: (fun outcome => observe (unwrap outcome)) <$> (sourceGame ...).run runtime = observe <$> (game ...).run runtime, for every observation observe (the form of the CE-12 headlines, 𝒟[decision <$> game] {true})
statements.classical_probEvent: Pr[event ∘ unwrap | (sourceGame ...).run runtime] = Pr[event | (game ...).run runtime] for every event (deprecated Pr API, local set_option linter.deprecated false in)
statements.classical_evalDist: 𝒟[(fun outcome => observe (unwrap outcome)) <$> (sourceGame ...).run runtime] = 𝒟[observe <$> (game ...).run runtime] for every observation observe into a measurable space Z (the evaluation-measure form of the CE-12 headlines; with Z = Bool and {true} the event form; added in the review fix pass so item 8 does not depend on the deprecated Pr API)

scan_spec.site_gate: The direct-reference scan walks the elaborated type and value (theorem bodies included, value? with allowOpaque) of every constant whose declaring module is the scanned module and records every occurrence of the projection FixedHkdfSha512NoSaltSource.crypto as (enclosing application head, argument position, head constant of the projected argument), metadata looked through; an occurrence outside an argument position is recorded with its position kind (lambda_body, let_value, declaration_value, ...) and an unapplied one as bare; every primitive projection node Expr.proj over the structure FixedHkdfSha512NoSaltSource is recorded with head primitive_projection. The scan fails (crypto site outside the allowed sites) unless every recorded site of the module is an entry (head, position, argument_head) of functional_field_allowlist_sites for that module (none for modules outside functional_field_allowlist_modules), and fails (site walker blind) when a declaration has an excused .crypto reference by getUsedConstants but no recorded site. Every table entry is checked against the head's type: the binder at that position must have type Pqxdh.Crypto. So the one-name allowance excuses the projection only at the listed sites of the listed modules, and a later edit that adds any other use fails the scan.
